newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WMC sells US oil unit for US$270.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: WMC sells US oil unit for US$270.5 mln.

text.p: WMC Ltd said on Monday it has agreed to sell all of the capital stock of its wholly-owned subsidiary Greenhill Petroleum Corp to Mesa Operating Co for US$270.5 million.
The sale was made between Western Mining Corp, wholly-owned by WMC, to Mesa Operating Co, wholly-owned by Mesa Inc, WMC said.
The sale, which is subject to completion of due diligence and regulatory approval, is expected to be closed on April 15, WMC said.

In August 1996, WMC announced its decision to sell all of its petroleum assets except its share of the Goldfields gas transmission pipeline, linking the offshore gas fields of northern offshore Western Australia with the state's major concentration of gold mines in the south.
Greenhill Petroleum owns the U.S. oil and gas assets of WMC. The Australian and New Zealand petroleum assets are also anticipated to be sold in the current financial year, WMC said.
